A Fellwar Stone is an artifact from Dominaria that enables its user to call forth mana from another mage or other artifacts.

Key threads from this canonical page lead to Magic: The Gathering, Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, Jared Carthalion, Dominaria, Golthonor and Ravidel. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

page.overview:
What is Fellwar Stone?

A Fellwar Stone is an artifact from Dominaria that enables its user to call forth mana from another mage or other artifacts.

Yorgo found one and gave it to Jared Carthalion so he could cast a spell on a scroll to enter Castle Melmereth. It was later used by Ravidel against Jared at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
